# Task-Laureate

> Task-Laureate is a free, open-source, privacy-minded task workspace for individuals who want to plan lists, prioritize work, track progress, and keep their data under their control.

## Short answer

Task-Laureate is a calm alternative to a noisy project-management system: capture a thought, choose a realistic window, and work from the next feasible action. It is free, open source, and designed local-first.

## What it does

- Creates lists and tasks with priorities, due dates, tags, rich notes, attachments, and required task dependencies.
- Makes work state explicit with To do, In progress, Blocked, and Done; completion is protected when required prerequisites remain unfinished.
- Shows progress, completed work, search, activity history, and concise dependency signals.
- Supports account-scoped Supabase sync with row-level security, optional social sign-in, export/import, and consent-controlled analytics.
- Works as a responsive web application and can be self-hosted on Vercel.

## What it does not claim

- It is not a replacement for an organization-wide project-management system; collaboration is intentionally focused on clear, private list and task sharing.
- Browser alerts are optional, device-specific, and best-effort; the in-app inbox is the durable notification record.
- It does not promise offline operation, real-time delivery, or universal AI/search ranking.

The creator is Aarti S Ravikumar: https://ai-aarti.com.

## Primary audience

Students, makers, and focused individuals who want a clean personal task workspace with transparent data handling.
